# Applying remediations generated by suite scans {id="installing-compliance-operator-cli_{{ context }}"}

Although you can use the `autoApplyRemediations` boolean parameter in a `ComplianceSuite` object, you can alternatively annotate the object with `compliance.openshift.io/apply-remediations`. This allows the Operator to apply all of the created remediations. {._abstract}

**Procedure**

*   Apply the `compliance.openshift.io/apply-remediations` annotation by running the following command:
    ```terminal
    $ oc -n openshift-compliance \
    annotate compliancesuites/workers-compliancesuite compliance.openshift.io/apply-remediations=
    ```
